propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket signatures omit library-supported parameters (force, reason, caused_by, ref), causing FastMCP to drop those keys before the registered callable executes
The MCP adapter delegates forward only close_class for transition and assignee for claim, losing even declared-but-unforwarded parameters
MCP ref selection defaults to HEAD instead of the requested immutable commit, and caused_by does not write the culprit edge, proving the adapter boundary strips values
The repair adds force (str | None) to both transition_ticket and claim_ticket, caused_by and optional ref to transition_ticket, and forwards all parameters unchanged to the library core
Absent force and missing required close_reason remain rejected; force_close and a separate close-reason field remain unavailable; absent certification is the audit signal

Tests confirm declared fields appear in live MCP schemas, exact values persist through the adapter to the library core, and both start-work and completion-close bypass semantics preserve their distinct types
